production.scenario: Microsoft Whiteboard merges strokes and sticky-note edits from classrooms with intermittent connectivity across continents.
components: global tablets and browsers producing strokes, notes, and cursor annotations offline or online
service boundary that authenticates rooms and batches collaborative deltas
control-plane service that uses CRDT rules to merge whiteboard state without central lockstep coordination
durable authority in Azure Cosmos DB for board state snapshots and durable deltas
pushes merged board state to viewers and presenters around the world
repair path that resends missed deltas after reconnect or classroom network outage
observability path for merge lag, offline backlog, and duplicate-apply suppression
flows: Client devices send batched whiteboard edits whenever connectivity permits.
The collaboration boundary forwards each board delta to the CRDT engine for convergence.
Merged board state and durable deltas are written to the authoritative board store.
The render layer publishes the converged board view to viewers, presenters, and recorders.
The authoritative store flags viewers and editors that missed durable delta ranges.
Repair replays the missing deltas through the same convergence engine before resending them.
Dashboards show board merge latency, offline recovery time, and duplicate suppression effectiveness.
